sdk.errorMessage: Revit 2027 (net10) builds require a .NET 10 SDK from the 10.0.4xx band. Install it from https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/10.0 — this folder exists only so that R27 builds can run on SDK 10 while the rest of the repo stays pinned to the fast SDK 8 (global.json in the repo root).
